name: alp
description: Read-only access to your own Alpaca brokerage balances, positions and activity, through the open-source alp CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your Alpaca brokerage account: what you hold and what it is worth, and what happened over a period (trade fills, dividends, interest, fees). Two read-only tools, alpaca_portfolio and alpaca_activities; nothing can trade, transfer or change your account. Your Alpaca API key pair stays on your computer: Claude Desktop keeps it in its own secure store and passes it to the bundled alp binary, which calls Alpaca's Trading API directly. Unofficial; not affiliated with Alpaca.

tools.name: alpaca_portfolio
tools.description: Your Alpaca account's balances and open positions.

tools.name: alpaca_activities
tools.description: Account activity over a date range: trade fills, dividends, interest and fees.

api_key_id.title: Alpaca API key ID
api_key_id.description: The key ID from the API Keys panel of your Alpaca dashboard. The pair can trade, so keep it to yourself; the tools here only read.

api_secret_key.title: Alpaca API secret key
api_secret_key.description: The secret key shown once beside the key ID when Alpaca issued the pair.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: live (the default) or paper. Live and paper accounts have different key pairs; use the pair issued for this one.
